textInfo.description: The definitive exposition of the Spanda (vibrational) principle of Consciousness. 52 verses demonstrating that Reality is neither an inert static void nor changing matter, but the ecstatic throb of divine Awareness.

verses.subDivision: Niḥsyanda 1: Svarūpa-spanda (Nature of the Divine Pulse)
verses.devanagari: यस्योन्मेषनिमेषाभ्यां जगतः प्रलयोदयौ । तं शक्तिचक्रविभवप्रभवं शङ्करं स्तुमः ॥ 1.1 ॥
verses.iast: yasyonmeṣanimeṣābhyāṃ jagataḥ pralayodayau | taṃ śakticakravibhavaprabhavaṃ śaṅkaraṃ stumaḥ || 1.1 ||
verses.studyGloss: We praise that Śaṅkara, the source of the glory of the wheel of powers, through whose opening and closing of awareness (Unmeṣa and Nimeṣa) the universe undergoes dissolution and emergence.
verses.practicalContext: The celebrated opening verse establishing that cosmic creation and dissolution are simply the opening and closing of Consciousness, and that Śaṅkara is the master of all energetic powers.

provenance.editionNotes: Based on edition by M. K. Shastri, Srinagar 1925, input by Oliver Hellwig, GRETIL.
